Tree Removal

Healthy trees, shaped the right way

  • Deadwood removal

About Crass Tree Experts

Three generations of tree work.

Nathaniel Crass grew up learning this trade firsthand. As a third-generation arborist, he brings decades of hands-on experience and generations of tree care knowledge to every job — from a single tree needing a trim to a full property cleanup after a storm.

We are a family-owned and operated company, rooted in Bel Air North. We treat every customer like a neighbor, with honest pricing and quality work — and a military discount for those who have served.
